stories.title: Autorità, almeno 309 i feriti nell'attacco degli Houthi all'aeroporto di Riad

en.title: Authorities: At least 309 injured in Houthi attack on Riyadh airport
en.summary: Civil aviation authorities report that a Houthi attack on Riyadh airport resulted in at least 309 people injured.

stories.title: Nyt, 'almeno 12 morti nell'attacco degli houthi all'aeroporto di Riad'

en.title: NYT: At least 12 dead in Houthi attack on Riyadh airport
en.summary: The New York Times reports that a Houthi attack on Riyadh airport killed at least 12 people, with at least 50 others wounded.

stories.title: Raid Houthi sull’Arabia Saudita, strage all’aeroporto di Riad: 12 morti

en.title: Houthi raid on Saudi Arabia, massacre at Riyadh airport: 12 dead
en.summary: Yemeni rebel Houthis attacked King Khalid airport in Riyadh, resulting in at least 12 deaths and dozens of injuries according to reports.

stories.title: 'Almeno due morti in attacco Houthi su scalo Riad, anche un'assistente di volo'

en.title: At least two dead in Houthi attack on Riyadh airport, including flight attendant
en.summary: Sources report that a Houthi attack on Riyadh airport killed at least two people, including a flight attendant.

stories.title: Crans, inchiesta per fuga di notizie. E gli indagati puntano allo sconto di pena: “Gogna mediatica”

en.title: Crans investigation into news leak. Defendants seek sentence reduction: "Media pillorying"
en.summary: Prosecutors are investigating attorneys and journalists in connection with leaked case documents. Defense lawyers for the Moretti defendants argue the publication of court records was reckless and may seek reduced sentences if convicted.

stories.title: Tromba d’aria a Marsala: la devastazione e il grande coraggio delle scuole

en.title: Tornado in Marsala: devastation and great courage of schools
en.summary: A tornado struck the Trapani area causing significant damage. A teacher protected her students with her own body during the disaster.

stories.title: Il monito del Papa: "La pena di morte è inammissibile"

en.title: Pope's warning: "Capital punishment is inadmissible"
en.summary: The Pope spoke against governments that continue to use capital punishment, citing the United States where the Pentagon announced a planned execution by firing squad to be streamed live.

stories.title: Procura di Sion apre inchiesta per fuga notizie su Crans-Montana

en.title: Sion prosecutor opens investigation into news leak on Crans-Montana
en.summary: Prosecutors are investigating the disclosure of classified documents and information to the press.

stories.title: Trump non esclude di unirsi ai raid sauditi, 'decideremo'

en.title: Trump does not rule out joining Saudi raids, 'we will decide'
en.summary: Trump commented on the possibility of US involvement in Saudi military operations following an attack on Riyadh airport.

stories.title: La Procura di Sion apre un'inchiesta per fuga notizie su Crans-Montana

en.title: Sion Prosecutor opens investigation into Crans-Montana information leak
en.summary: Authorities are investigating the unauthorized disclosure of classified documents and information to the media by judicial officials.

stories.title: Rigettato il ricorso di Ranucci, la redazione: "Mai sfiduciato o chiesto la sua rimozione"

en.title: Ranucci's Appeal Rejected, Editorial Staff: "Never Removed Trust or Asked for His Removal"
en.summary: A journalist's appeal against a Rai decision was rejected, confirming the legitimacy of a Rai3 program reorganization. The editorial staff stated it responds to controversies through investigations.

stories.title: Riad, aeroporto colpito da missile Houthi: almeno 12 morti. Trump: “Potremmo unirci ai raid sauditi”

en.title: Riyadh airport hit by Houthi missile: at least 12 dead. Trump: "We could join Saudi raids"
en.summary: A missile strike on Riyadh airport caused fatalities and injuries, forcing airport closure. A projectile also landed near Dammam airport. Trump indicated possible US military participation in response.

stories.title: Ex Ilva: «Stop per l’ordine dei giudici e perché siamo senza materie prime»

en.title: Ex Ilva: "Stoppage due to court order and lack of raw materials"
en.summary: The company cited unrealistic conditions imposed by magistrates within 90 days and stated it halted purchasing for production due to anticipated plant closure.

stories.title: Tatuaggi e piercing, imprese più che raddoppiate in 10 anni

en.title: Tattoos and piercings, businesses more than doubled in 10 years
en.summary: Tattoo and piercing businesses in Italy increased by 160 percent between 2017 and 2026, with Rome leading in absolute numbers and Bari showing the fastest growth rate.

stories.title: L’export resiste alla crisi energetica. Diversificare chiave per la crescita

en.title: Exports resist energy crisis. Diversification key for growth
en.summary: A Promos Italia white paper examines Italian export trends between 2021 and 2026, analyzing how exports have performed through economic and geopolitical challenges.

stories.title: Parte a Torino il progetto per il “super caccia”. In arrivo duemila posti

en.title: Turin launches 'super fighter' project. Two thousand jobs coming
en.summary: Edgewing, a joint venture between Leonardo, BAE Systems, and Jaiec, is opening its first development and design facility in Turin, with aircraft production planned for Caselle.

stories.title: Tecnologia e spinta estera per la Liuc del futuro

en.title: Technology and international push for Liuc's future
en.summary: Liuc university is integrating artificial intelligence into its programs while expanding international engagement and strengthening connections with businesses through external partnerships.
